name: WordLimitTextArea
tagline: Word Limit Text Area replaces the plain multi-line text box on a form.
description: Word Limit Text Area replaces the plain multi-line text box on a form. As people type, it shows a live count of words (or characters) against the limit you set, a slim progress bar, and a friendly message when the answer is too short or too long. You decide whether the limit is a gentle warning or a hard stop.
